sources.title: Altitude — Our Design System & AI Testbed — Southleft
sources.snippet: Altitude is Southleft's in-house design system: a Figma-to-production ecosystem built on Lit web components and Style Dictionary tokens — and the testbed for every AI integration we run.

sources.title: A2UI Bridge
sources.snippet: Let AI agents build real user interfaces. A React implementation of Google's A2UI protocol for AI-generated UIs using your design system.

sources.title: GitHub - southleft/a2ui-bridge: Framework adapters for Google's A2UI ...
sources.snippet: Let AI agents create real user interfaces using any component library. A2UI Bridge implements Google's A2UI Protocol for React, enabling AI-generated UIs that render with your existing design system.
